metadataReview.note: Radio Habana Cuba describes Antonio Maceo's invading column camping at the settlement of Las Taironas on 17 January 1896 and meeting a Spanish force that held positions on the nearby road from Pinar del Río to La Coloma, including a bridge, buildings and roadside ditches. The Calendario Cubano entry quotes the invasion diaries placing the combat at Las Taironas at the gates of Pinar del Río. The atlas point is the gazetteer node for the Las Taironas hamlet south-east of the city; it is a settlement-sector reference, not the Spanish road position or either column's line. The existing date is retained. Strengths, losses and equipment are not inferred; figures quoted in the sources are not adopted.
